WORDS and MUSIC: Kittie L. Suffield, 1929. Public Domain.
Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre. Psa. 45:6 God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness. 47:8
